options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: The recursive call uses a+1 instead of a-1, so a keeps increasing and the base case a <= 1 is never reached; the stack overflows, causing a segmentation fault. 6 would be printed only with factorial(a-1).

questions.question: In pointer implementation of linked lists, which operation can be performed in constant time (O(1)) when inserting or deleting nodes?

options.D: Deleting a specific node

questions.explanation: Inserting at the beginning only requires updating the new node's next pointer and the head pointer, which is O(1). Inserting at the end (without a tail pointer) or at a position requires traversal, O(n).

questions.question: The main advantage of the overlay technique in memory management is that it allows:

options.A: Processes to be loaded into memory as a whole
options.C: Large programs to be executed on systems with limited memory
options.D: Processes to communicate directly with each other

questions.explanation: Overlays keep only the needed part of a program in memory and load other parts over it when required, so programs larger than available memory can run. They do not load the whole process at once.

questions.question: What is encapsulation in OOP?

options.A: The ability to inherit properties from multiple classes
options.C: The bundling of data and methods that operate on the data
options.D: The use of abstract classes only

questions.explanation: Encapsulation bundles data and the methods that operate on it into a single unit (class), usually hiding internal details. Inheriting from multiple classes is multiple inheritance.

questions.question: The matrix contains m rows and n columns. The matrix is called Sparse Matrix if

options.B: total number of zero elements = m+n
options.C: total number of zero elements = m/n
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A matrix is called sparse when most of its elements are zero, that is, the number of zero elements exceeds half of the total m*n elements.

questions.question: What is the primary function of a router in a computer network?

options.A: To connect devices within the same network
options.C: To filter incoming traffic based on IP addresses
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A router connects different networks and forwards packets between them using IP addresses. Connecting devices within the same network is the job of a switch.

questions.question: The expression Y=AB+BC+AC shows the _____ operation.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Y = AB + BC + AC is a sum (OR) of product (AND) terms, so it is in SOP form. POS would be a product of sum terms.

questions.question: In Huffman coding, which characters are usually assigned shorter codes?

options.D: Characters with shorter ASCII values

questions.explanation: Huffman coding gives shorter codes to more frequent characters, minimising the total encoded length. Code length depends on frequency, not ASCII value.

questions.question: How do structures and classes in C++ differ?

options.A: In structures, members are private by default whereas in classes, they are public by default
options.B: In structures, members are public by default whereas in classes, they are private by default
options.C: Structures cannot have private members whereas classes can have
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: In C++, struct members are public by default and class members are private by default. Structures can still have private members.

questions.question: Monitors are primarily used for achieving:

options.D: Process termination

questions.explanation: A monitor is a high-level synchronization construct that guarantees mutual exclusion (only one process active inside) and supports condition synchronization. Deadlock and starvation are problems to be avoided.

questions.concept: RSVP is not an application protocol
questions.question: Which one of the following is not an application layer protocol used in internet?

options.D: None of these

questions.explanation: Resource Reservation Protocol (RSVP) is a transport/network-level signalling protocol for reserving resources, not an application layer protocol. RPC and IRC operate at the application layer.

questions.question: _____ is a set of one or more attribute(s) taken collectively to uniquely identify a record.

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A superkey is any set of one or more attributes that together uniquely identify a tuple. A primary key is a chosen minimal candidate key, and a foreign key references another relation.

questions.question: Which of the following is a file system commonly used in operating systems?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: NTFS and FAT32 (Windows) and HFS+ (macOS) are all widely used file systems.

questions.question: Zigbee is a task group in ________

options.D: WAN

questions.explanation: Zigbee is built on IEEE 802.15.4, the low-rate Wireless Personal Area Network (WPAN) standard.

questions.question: What is the difference between delete and delete[ ] in C++?

options.A: Delete is syntactically correct but delete[ ] is wrong and hence will give an error if used in any case
options.B: Delete is used to delete normal objects whereas delete[ ] is used to delete pointer objects
options.C: Delete is used to delete single object whereas delete[ ] is used to delete multiple (array/ pointer of) objects
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: delete frees a single object allocated with new, while delete[] frees an array of objects allocated with new[]. Both are valid syntax and both work on pointers.

questions.question: The minimum number of states required to recognize an octal number divisible by 3 is
questions.explanation: A DFA for divisibility by 3 only needs to track the remainder of the number read so far modulo 3, i.e. 0, 1 or 2, giving 3 states regardless of base (octal here).

questions.question: In a PLA, what components are used to implement the combinational logic functions?

options.D: NOT gates and multiplexers

questions.explanation: A Programmable Logic Array has a programmable AND plane that forms product terms and a programmable OR plane that sums them, so it implements SOP functions with AND and OR gates. NAND/XOR or multiplexer combinations are not its structure.

questions.question: Which of the following is the basic approach for joining tables?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Tables can be combined using union joins, natural joins and subqueries, so more than one of the given approaches is a basic approach for joining tables.

questions.question: ________ is an agreement between the communicating parties on how communication is to proceed over a network.

options.D: Antivirus

questions.explanation: A protocol is a set of agreed rules governing how communication proceeds between parties over a network. Ethernet is one specific LAN technology.

questions.question: Which among the following is associated with Excel?

options.D: Spreadsheet

questions.explanation: MS Excel is a spreadsheet program. Word is a word processor and PowerPoint a presentation program.

questions.concept: SSI and MSI in third generation
questions.question: Which of the following IC was used in third generation of computers?

options.D: Both (A) and (B)

questions.explanation: Third generation computers used small-scale (SSI) and medium-scale (MSI) integrated circuits. LSI and VLSI belong to the fourth generation.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not the application of the stack data structure?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Asynchronous data transfer (e.g. buffers, pipes) uses a queue. String reversal and backtracking are classic stack applications.

questions.question: What consists of the identification of risks or threats, the implementation of security measures, and the monitoring of those measures for effectiveness?

options.D: None of the above

questions.explanation: Risk management is the full cycle of identifying risks, applying controls and monitoring them. Risk assessment is only the identification/analysis step.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an attribute of the <font> tag?

options.D: color

questions.explanation: The HTML <font> tag supports face, size and color attributes. height is not an attribute of <font>.

questions.question: ISO 9000 and SEI CMM are both frameworks related to:

options.C: Software quality standards and process improvement
options.D: Software development languages

questions.explanation: ISO 9000 is a quality management standard and SEI CMM is a process maturity model; both deal with software quality and process improvement, not protocols, architecture or languages.
